base_branch.description: The remote branch Spec branches are cut from.

prefix.description: The prefix of every branch the Factory creates.

effort.description: The reasoning effort every Step uses unless the Step sets its own.

factory.description: A semver range the Factory's version must match, e.g. "1".

harness.description: The Harness every Step uses unless the Step sets its own.

claude_code.description: Settings of the Claude Code Harness.

access_key_id.description: Where the AWS access key id comes from (method = "bedrock"). Setting a Harness credential is allowed only in config.local.toml or as a CLI flag, never in config.toml.

command.description: Run this command and use its stdout.

dotenv.description: Read this key from .fliesswerk/.env, which must be git-ignored.

stored.description: Read this key from the user-level credentials file written by `fliesswerk auth set`.

i_accept_long_lived_keys_in_sandbox.description: Hand your own AWS credentials to every Sandbox as they are, instead of short-lived, Bedrock-only ones (method = "bedrock"). The agent can read them, and every Run warns. Setting the acknowledgement for passing AWS credentials through is allowed only in config.local.toml or as a CLI flag, never in config.toml.

role_arn.description: A role to assume for Bedrock (method = "bedrock").

secret.description: Where the token or API key comes from. A subscription token (method = "oauth_token") can't be `stored`. Setting a Harness credential is allowed only in config.local.toml or as a CLI flag, never in config.toml.

command.description: Run this command and use its stdout.

dotenv.description: Read this key from .fliesswerk/.env, which must be git-ignored.

stored.description: Read this key from the user-level credentials file written by `fliesswerk auth set`.

secret_access_key.description: Where the AWS secret access key comes from (method = "bedrock"). Setting a Harness credential is allowed only in config.local.toml or as a CLI flag, never in config.toml.

command.description: Run this command and use its stdout.

dotenv.description: Read this key from .fliesswerk/.env, which must be git-ignored.

stored.description: Read this key from the user-level credentials file written by `fliesswerk auth set`.

hooks.description: Hooks, by the moment they run at.

run_end.description: Runs on the host when a Run ends.

parallel.description: Shell commands run at once; on the first failure the others are stopped.

secrets.description: Project secrets a host Hook gets (Sandbox Hooks get them all).

timeout.description: Stop the Hook after this long. Default 5m.

run_start.description: Runs on the host when a Run starts.

parallel.description: Shell commands run at once; on the first failure the others are stopped.

secrets.description: Project secrets a host Hook gets (Sandbox Hooks get them all).

timeout.description: Stop the Hook after this long. Default 5m.

sandbox_created.description: Runs when a Sandbox has been created.

parallel.description: Shell commands run at once; on the first failure the others are stopped.

secrets.description: Project secrets a host Hook gets (Sandbox Hooks get them all).

timeout.description: Stop the Hook after this long. Default 5m.

spec_finished.description: Runs on the host when a Spec's last Ticket, or a standalone Ticket, closes.

parallel.description: Shell commands run at once; on the first failure the others are stopped.

secrets.description: Project secrets a host Hook gets (Sandbox Hooks get them all).

timeout.description: Stop the Hook after this long. Default 5m.

keep_days.description: How many days Run logs are kept: a positive whole number, or "forever".

max_iterations.description: How many Iterations a Run may have. Default 10.

max_parallel.description: How many Tickets an Iteration works on at once. Default 1.

model.description: The model every Step uses unless the Step sets its own.

ca_certs.description: PEM files trusted in every Sandbox on top of the system roots.

upstream_proxy.description: The proxy the egress proxy chains to, instead of the host's HTTPS_PROXY.

protected_paths.description: Extra Protected paths: files, directories or globs the agent may not change.

sandbox.description: The Sandbox each Step runs in.

engine.description: The container engine, for the container Sandbox and for Services. Setting the container engine, which depends on each person's machine, is allowed only in config.local.toml or as a CLI flag, never in config.toml.

env.description: Environment variables set in every Sandbox. Not for secrets: use [sandbox.secrets].

i_accept_unsandboxed_risk.description: Required with kind = "none": you accept that the agent runs with no Sandbox. Setting the acknowledgement for running without a Sandbox is allowed only in config.local.toml or as a CLI flag, never in config.toml.

kind.description: The Sandbox kind. "none" also needs i_accept_unsandboxed_risk = true. Setting the Sandbox kind, which depends on each person's machine, is allowed only in config.local.toml or as a CLI flag, never in config.toml.

allow.description: Hosts the Sandbox may reach, besides the Harness's own endpoints. Setting allow = ["*"] (open network) is allowed only in config.local.toml or as a CLI flag, never in config.toml.

read_only_paths.description: Extra paths a native Sandbox may read.

command.description: Run this command and use its stdout.

dotenv.description: Read this key from .fliesswerk/.env, which must be git-ignored.

stored.description: Read this key from the user-level credentials file written by `fliesswerk auth set`.

secrets.description: Project secrets, by environment variable name, each naming where it comes from.

withhold_secrets.description: Keep the project secrets from the agent and from verify: only Hooks get them. Default true.

writable_paths.description: Extra paths a native Sandbox may write.

shared.description: One copy serves the whole Run instead of one per Sandbox.

services.description: Services from the compose file, by name.

compose_file.description: The compose file Services come from.

standards.description: The Coding standards file, read only by the review Step.

effort.description: The reasoning effort for this Step, if the Harness has one.

harness.description: The Harness for this Step. A Step that sets it must also set `model`.

idle_timeout.description: Stop the Step after this long without output. Default 10m.

timeout.description: Stop the Step after this long. Default 60m.

harness.description: The Harness for this Step. A Step that sets it must also set `model`.

timeout.description: Stop the Step after this long. Default 60m.

effort.description: The reasoning effort for this Step, if the Harness has one.

timeout.description: Stop the Step after this long. Default 60m.

cannot_do_label.description: The label a Ticket gets when the agent can't do it.

in_progress_label.description: The label that marks a claimed Spec.

ready_label.description: The label that marks a Ticket Ready for agent.

token.description: Where the Tracker token comes from. Setting a Tracker credential is allowed only in config.local.toml or as a CLI flag, never in config.toml.

command.description: Run this command and use its stdout.

dotenv.description: Read this key from .fliesswerk/.env, which must be git-ignored.

stored.description: Read this key from the user-level credentials file written by `fliesswerk auth set`.

update_notice.description: Say when a newer Fliesswerk is out, at most once a day and never in CI. Default true.

verify.description: Names from [commands] the Factory runs itself to check a change.

version.description: The config format version. Must be 1.
